name: Starcom Information Technology Limited
about: Starcom Information Technology Limited provides, data quality, business intelligence, and data analytics solutions in India. The company operates in two segments: Test, Measurement & Embedded Solutions for Educational Sector; and Data Quality, Statistical and Analytics Software. It also offers master data management, and computer-aided engineering. Its products include StarDQ, a real time automated enterprise solution for data cleansing, de-duping, clustering, and enriching the data; and StarBI, a business intelligence software that allows business users to discover trends, track KPIs, and visualize data. The company also offers Star360, an automated platform that serves as single point of contact for front-end digital systems, CRM systems, business intelligence, call centers, bots, and mobile apps to deliver the 360 degrees view of the customer. In addition, it serves retail, education, telecom, BFSI, healthcare, and government sectors. The company was formerly known as Jatia Finance Limited and changed its name to Starcom Information Technology Limited in December 2008. Starcom Information Technology Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Bengaluru, India.
